published_prior_art.cite: lin2025tightening treats covariate-aware COT with fixed information; das2011submodular treats one-response regression sparse selection, not the two-arm Gaussian COT endpoint.
bian2017guarantees gives abstract non-submodular greedy theory and tight generic constructions, not a realizable unequal-scale Gaussian conditional-transport family.
das2011submodular and bian2017guarantees supply the generic weak-submodular greedy recurrence; novelty is inherited from the new COT certificate.
ji2023modelagnostic already supplies selection-valid inference; the proposed Gaussian endpoint influence map and equality degeneracy characterization are a specialization.
imbensmanski2004ci and stoye2021neverempty establish general partial-identification interval principles; this is a COT-specific conservative projection implementation.
das2011submodular, bian2017guarantees, and elenberg2018restricted do not determine the exact fixed-budget frontier over realizable unequal-scale Gaussian COT objectives.

soundness_flags.label: symbol rho_k / oeq:exact-fixed-budget-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The definition infimizes over undefined shorthand M_{p,k} and says only that p is “compatible” with K,R, so it does not specify the law class or quantify the admissible (m,M,s,V) tuples.

soundness_flags.label: ass:compact-inference-class / thm:split-wald / thm:whole-class-projection
soundness_flags.one_line: theta is a finite-dimensional moment parameter whereas Mpk is defined as a class of probability laws, so “theta is a compact subset of Mpk” is type-incoherent; define a compact parameter image Theta={theta(P):P in Mpk} and state the inference theorems over it.

source_verification_receipts.locator: §3.3, Proposition 3.6 and Example 3.8 (printed p. 4); §5.1, Lemma 5.1 (printed p. 6); §6
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves interpolation of its covariate-aware lower bound, gives a Gaussian linear example and Gaussian-noise conditional formula, and identifies variable selection for tighter PI sets as future work.
The paper defines the submodularity ratio, lower-bounds it through sparse covariance eigenvalues for regression, and gives the forward-regression approximation guarantee.
The paper proves a tight cardinality-constrained greedy guarantee governed by generalized curvature and submodularity ratio for generic non-submodular monotone set functions.
The paper gives model-agnostic inference for partially identified causal estimands and states that multiplier bootstrap can select covariates and models without sacrificing validity.

The paper formulates covariate-assisted causal partial identification through COT and develops direct adapted-Wasserstein-based estimation with convergence rates, rather than a cardinality-constrained selection frontier.
The paper develops a smooth-density wavelet COT estimator and establishes asymptotic normality for quadratic cost, providing fixed-target inference rather than a sparse-budget selection guarantee.
The paper constructs a never-empty interval for a parameter bounded by estimated lower and upper bounds with asymptotically normal estimators.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define rho_k with explicit quantifiers over p,m,M,s,V and ratios M/m=K,V/s=R, or prove a scale-normalization lemma that makes the reduced definition invariant.
Replace the compact-inference condition by a named compact parameter image Theta and state continuity, covariance, and nondegeneracy conditions directly on Theta.
Add a worked k=2 instance of the unequal-scale family calculating its singleton and joint gains, then use it to motivate a sharper fixed-k conjecture or certificate.

recommended_next_step: Repair the two ill-posed parameter/class definitions, then advance the field-grade angular-frontier kernel to Stage 0.
